purpose: Explicitly inventory existing self-owned pre-B05 Activity/Event rows without a primary Life Area; no inferred default or silent migration.

routine.return_type: TABLE(subject_kind text, subject_native_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Organizational assignment is product state; never a Domain MaterialStateRef.
state_history.current_binding: Exactly one current actor-local primary Life Area per assigned item; older unassigned items remain explicit.
state_history.chronology: Current assignment revision and assigned_at are server-accepted organizational state.
state_history.immutability_policy: CAS advances the actor-local revision; earlier transitions persist as receipts.

lifecycle.retention: Retain archived-area associations and accepted transition history; no implicit reassignment.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime has no direct DELETE; forward-only migration refuses destructive downgrade.

obligations: True typed FK to item, Person and Life Area; no polymorphic owner or NativeAddress pollution.
Actor self scope, archived-target rejection, idempotency and CAS are verified in PostgreSQL.
No runtime raw table access; B04 scheduling is unaffected.
